memoryBuilder.verseText: The battle belongs to God. He saves His own way.

sequence.prompt: What happened in the valley? Put it in order.

items.label: The giant shouted at God's people
Every soldier was too afraid to go
One stone flew, and the giant fell

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: They won without throwing one stone
David took it off — it was not his
He measured the giant against God

application.question: The soldiers were saved by someone else's victory. What feels giant-sized to you today?
application.followUp: You do not have to be David in this story — you get to be one of the soldiers on the hill. Jesus went out and won the battle you could never win. The battle is God's.
